verdict.rationale: The docs describe a settlement flow in which the CDP Facilitator submits settlement onchain and reports the result to the resource server. Sellers receive funds at any address they control, including Coinbase Business or Prime, and x402 can be enabled on a Payment Acceptance merchant checkout. However, reporting is only a per-request settlement confirmation, not a merchant reporting or reconciliation flow comparable to other payment channels. missing for 10: documented merchant reporting/statements, reconciliation tooling or exports that unify x402 with other channels, payout/off-ramp documentation, independent corroboration of reconciliation in practice.
